description: Architect-adjacent. Reality gets thin and strange. Sanity damage is real; so is whatever you see.

phantoms.arrive: There's someone standing where you're standing, half a step out of true, mouthing along to the thoughts as you think them.
barks: The one standing inside you thinks your next thought a half-second early. You hear it in your own voice.
It shifts its weight when you shift yours, but always a little wrong, a little late.
phantoms.depart: You breathe out and it breathes out with you, and then only you're breathing.
phantoms.look: It's you, rendered by something that has only ever read about you. The proportions are right. Nothing else is.
phantoms.name: someone standing exactly where you are
phantoms.talk: It answers in your voice, from somewhere inside your chest: "There's no one here but us, and there's no us."

phantoms.arrive: A vertical seam opens in the wall where no seam was, wide enough for one eye, and the eye is open.
barks: The seam widens by a hair. Behind it, the eye tracks you across the room.
Through the gap you can see the room you're in, from the other side, with you standing in it.
phantoms.depart: The seam presses shut and the wall forgets it was ever anything but wall.
phantoms.look: The edges of it are too clean, like a cut in a photograph. What's behind isn't dark. It's more room, wrong-way-round.
phantoms.name: a seam in the wall that's watching
phantoms.talk: The eye doesn't blink. The seam widens, very slightly, as if leaning closer to listen.

phantoms.arrive: A small figure resolves out of the glare on a nearby surface: a child's shape, edged in cold light, facing the wrong way.
barks: The glare-child raises one arm and points at something behind you. You don't turn around.
It hums a tune you almost recognise, in a key that doesn't exist.
phantoms.depart: The light shifts by an inch and takes the shape of the child with it.
phantoms.look: Look straight at it and it's only a smear of reflected light. Look away and it's a child again, and closer.
phantoms.name: a child made of window-glare

effects.onset_message: The room starts to look thin and unreal.

overdose.message: Nothing around you looks solid any more. Something looks at you and says your name, and when it goes, part of your mind goes with it.

phases.comedown_message: The walls stop moving, mostly. Things still look a bit wrong.
phases.comeup_message: The light goes thin and grey, and the colours fade.
phases.end_message: Things look solid again. You think you're alone.

withdrawal.message: Everything feels too solid and too loud. You keep staring at the walls, looking for a gap.

stages.easing: The world stops pressing in so hard.
stages.onset: The world goes solid again. Everything looks exactly like what it is.
stages.peak: Everything's solid and certain, but what you saw through the gaps is still there. You just can't see it now.
stages.rising: You keep checking corners for a gap, and they're just corners.
stages.tail: Everything's solid and ordinary again. Not everything you saw has gone away.

name: Glasshollow
